# QS-CFW-5998-73 - Quality specification - track link CFW-5998-73 (15B37)

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P2  
Parts: CFW-5998-73

Scope
- Defines acceptance criteria and inspection methods for finished track link CFW-5998-73 (CFW-5998-73) manufactured at Plant P2. Applies to all production lots and repairs for part CFW-5998-73.

Requirements table
| Characteristic | Requirement | Acceptance |
|---|---:|---|
| Hardness | The hardness range for track link CFW-5998-73 (CFW-5998-73) is 34-38 HRC. | All measured locations must fall within range. |
| Bore diameter tolerance | The bore diameter tolerance for track link CFW-5998-73 (CFW-5998-73) is ±0.10 mm. | Measured bore diameters must be within nominal ±0.10 mm. |
| Maximum forging weight | The maximum forging weight for track link CFW-5998-73 (CFW-5998-73) is 4.8 kg. | Forged blank weight must not exceed 4.8 kg. |

Inspection method
- Sampling: Inspect parts per lot sampling plan in the manufacturing control system. Record measurements on the lot inspection record.
- Hardness: Verify hardness using a calibrated portable or bench Rockwell tester capable of HRC scale. Take measurements at representative locations specified on the inspection drawing and record values. Compare recorded values to "The hardness range for track link CFW-5998-73 (CFW-5998-73) is 34-38 HRC."
- Bore measurement: Measure bore diameters with calibrated bore gauge or plug gauge against nominal. Document measurements and verify they conform to "The bore diameter tolerance for track link CFW-5998-73 (CFW-5998-73) is ±0.10 mm."
- Weight: Weigh forged blanks on calibrated scale and confirm weight does not exceed "The maximum forging weight for track link CFW-5998-73 (CFW-5998-73) is 4.8 kg."

Nonconformance handling
- If any characteristic fails to meet the stated requirement, segregate affected parts and tag as NR (nonconforming). Initiate containment and notify Quality. Perform root cause and corrective action per corrective action procedure. Disposition must be approved by Quality prior to release or rework.
